how_to_use: Engine implements every 'core' op generically. 'bespoke' ops are used by one or two items: implement them as a named hook on that item, or until then hand the item's text to the Narrator. Any op the engine doesn't recognise must fall back to the Narrator, never be silently ignored.

Not automatable: the Narrator (AI or human) decides using the item's text.

A Mastered word's inflection (rules 1.9, Sigil 1.5): one small upgrade of that word, always on for its caster. stat names the number it moves (cond_rounds, save_tn, to_hit, damage_pct, push_tiles, shield_pct, heal_pct, charge, flux, lasts_rounds, radius, teleport_tiles, barrier_hp_pct, move_tiles, range, turret_def, pull_tiles, jump_radius, leech, mult, radius_at_4, cone_length, spare_downed); a stat the engine does not run goes to the Narrator with the text.
